title: incident-bot: oncall runbook linking helpers and SLO toolkit utilities
author: Maya Thompson
description:
Motivation: improve incident-bot's ability to surface relevant runbooks and SLO-related helpers during on-call diagnostics. This change introduces a set of lightweight helper utilities in the SLO toolkit and a runbook-linking scoring component used by the incident-bot to rank and surface runbook links in alert context messages. The goal is to increase the signal-to-noise ratio for on-call engineers and reduce time-to-remediation by surfacing higher-quality runbook suggestions and SLO hints.

What changed: added a runbook linker with scoring heuristics that consider SLO tags, recent incident matches, and runbook freshness; exposed SLO toolkit helper functions for extracting SLO metadata and hint generation; added telemetry hooks for link click-through and suggestion acceptance rates; minor user-facing formatting improvements for runbook quick-links in Slack/IM; unit and integration tests; docs page update.

Checklist: 
- [x] core runbook-linker implementation (incident-bot/src/runbook_linker.py)
- [x] SLO toolkit helpers (slo-toolkit/src/hints.py)
- [x] telemetry events and metrics (observability-pack/metrics.yaml + incident-bot telemetry client)
- [x] unit tests and e2e coverage for runbook flow
- [x] docs and examples updated (redwood-docs/oncall/runbooks.md)

Notes: The scoring model is intentionally simple and deterministic (no ML) so it is auditable and fast in hot paths. Scoring factors: SLO match score, recent incident match bonus, runbook last_updated decay, manual priority override. Future work tracked in ENG-2201: experiment with context-aware reranking and ML-based suggestions.

Compatibility: backwards-compatible API surface; feature gated behind a config flag incident_bot.enable_runbook_linking (default: off for rollout).

Migration/rollout: feature will be enabled via canary on a subset of on-call teams, telemetry will be monitored for click-through and false-positive rates.

References: Linear ENG-2134, ENG-2201; related PRs: pr-121234, pr-118888.
